title: Terraform against Google Cloud: provider, project and credentials

videos.script: You already know Terraform. This lesson is about pointing it at Google Cloud. {{terraform}} Three questions come first. Which project does a resource land in? Which region? And whose identity does Terraform act with? {{questions}} The provider block answers the first two. It answers the third by saying nothing at all. The provider looks for credentials in a fixed order, and takes the first it finds. {{order}} On a laptop, that is your own login. In a pipeline, it is the machine's service account. A key file in the repository is never the answer. {{key}} Then you will create a bucket, and see what an imitation forgets. Its location comes back wrong, and Terraform proposes to destroy it. {{drift}}
